title: Nested Patch PCR enables highly multiplexed mutation discovery in candidate genes
boundary: Uracil-containing initial PCR primers are removed, then nested splint oligos guide universal-primer ligation; a terminal three-carbon blocker protects selected products during exonuclease selection.
